program.name: Balance & Core
program.subject: Balance & stability
program.blurb: Balance work and core stability together: one-leg drills, Copenhagen planks and anti-rotation holds.
program.about: Balance and core stability together, since each helps the other. A balance circuit comes first, then a core-stability circuit with Copenhagen planks, planks and anti-rotation work, then abs. Two days alternate the drills. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations. You need a chair for the Copenhagen plank.
program.gear: A sturdy chair for the Copenhagen plank.
